name: caregrid
description: Clinical appointment scheduling and resource planning: Next.js + Tailwind + TypeScript frontend, Express + SQL backend

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c teal,yellow "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web "npm --prefix backend start" "npm --prefix frontend start"
